title: Review new code for bugs (read-only; do NOT edit files, do NOT run cargo builds — a full build is running already). The…
summary: I found 4 high-severity and 7 medium-severity defects, plus one latent token leak. I read the code only; nothing was built or run. There are no deadlocks: no parking_lot guard is held across an `.await`, and `send_directories` holds `links` only while it calls the directory, which takes its own lock and never takes `links`.
